INSERT INTO CDM.ST_C_COM_CD_TRANS
SELECT T1.GENE_ST_EN_TAB_NAME, T1.GENE_ST_CN_TAB_NAME, T1.GENE_ST_EN_FIELD_NAME, T1.GENE_ST_CN_FIELD_NAME,
  T1.BASE_ST_EN_TAB_NAME, T1.BASE_ST_CN_TAB_NAME, T1.BASE_ST_EN_FIELD_NAME, T1.BASE_ST_CN_FIELD_NAME,
  T2.STAND_CD_VAL, T2.STAND_CD_DESC
FROM CDM.C_COM_CD_TRANS_CONFIG T1
INNER JOIN FDM.F_CO_TRANS_CD T2
  ON T1.BASE_ST_EN_TAB_NAME = T2.F_EN_TAB_NAME
  AND T1.BASE_ST_EN_FIELD_NAME = T2.F_EN_FIELD_NAME
  AND T2.start_dt <= DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}' AND T2.end_dt > DATE'{ETL_TX_DT}';

knowledgeBlocks.blockName: 闭链旧数据并插入新数据
knowledgeBlocks.sqlCode:
UPDATE CDM.C_COM_CD_TRANS F SET F.end_dt = DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}'
WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM CDM.VT_C_COM_CD_TRANS T WHERE F.end_dt = DATE '{MAX_DATE}'
  AND T.gene_st_en_tab_name = F.gene_st_en_tab_name AND T.gene_st_en_field_name = F.gene_st_en_field_name AND T.cd_val = F.cd_val);

INSERT INTO CDM.C_COM_CD_TRANS
SELECT ..., DATE '{ETL_TX_DT}', DATE '{MAX_DATE}'
FROM CDM.VT_C_COM_CD_TRANS T
GROUP BY T.gene_st_en_tab_name, T.gene_st_cn_tab_name, T.gene_st_en_field_name, T.gene_st_cn_field_name,
  T.base_st_en_tab_name, T.base_st_cn_tab_name, T.base_st_en_field_name, T.base_st_cn_field_name, T.cd_val, T.cd_descn;
